EmailTemplate.subject: ON THE FLY: Tips, trends, and strategies for 2021
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
It's time to plan your 2021 Bounce Back! We've been hard at work compiling a playbook for with tips, trends, and strategies for resilient travel companies around the world. Click below to join us for a live webinar on November 12!
Bouncing Back 2021 Playbook: Tips, Trends, and Strategies for Resilient Travel Companies
Flywire has put together a playbook to help travel companies bounce back in 2021. Join us for a live webinar on November 12 as we discuss these topics with a panel of travel industry professionals.
Register now: <[https://more.flywire.com/BouncingBackPlaybookWebinar.html?utm_source=OnTheFly]>
More from Flywire
Diversity in Adventure Travel
Flywire has partnered with the Adventure Travel Trade Association on a new report examining diversity in adventure travel. The findings indicate that promoting diversity and inclusion is not only the right thing to do, but also an economic imperative.
Read the report <[[https://assets.flywire.com/documents/Diversity-in-Adventure-Travel.pdf?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Reducing Chargeback Risk in the Travel Industry
As businesses in all sectors focus on preserving capital and reducing risk, few are facing as many challenges as those in the travel industry. One such challenge is preventing credit card chargebacks.
Read the blog <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/reducing-chargeback-risk-in-the-travel-industry?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
